adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, the dialog is always mounted by `BookingListItem` (`<AddGuestsDialog ... />` is rendered unconditionally), so its internal `useState` persists across open/close cycles. The `Dialog` uses `onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}`, so closing via Esc/backdrop only toggles `isOpenDialog` and does not reset `multiEmailValue` or `isInvalidEmail`. Also, the mutation `onSuccess` resets `multiEmailValue` but never clears `isInvalidEmail`, so an invalid banner can remain true and be shown again (even over a reset/empty form) on subsequent opens.
